description: 17 nálezů z čtvrtého kola hloubkového auditu (commit 2176b0e, 2026-11-08). acceptance_criteria: Learning event append and candidate projection write use the same SQLite connection and transaction.
A repeated identical transition is idempotent and does not create a second logical event.
Injected failures before/after event append and before/after projection leave both event and projection unchanged.
task_t06_learning_atomicity.description: Ukládat event a projekci v jedné SQLite transakci pomocí append_in_transaction(). Implementovat idempotenci opakovaného přechodu. Testovat selhání před/po eventu a před/po projekci. Priority: high.
task_t06_learning_atomicity.next_action: Event append plus learning projection share one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction via append_in_transaction(strict_idempotency=True). Create, advance, promote and rollback use the atomic helper; duplicate transition retry returns the existing projection. Four injected failure points roll back both. Historical focused validation: 27 passed, 15 deselected across learning/storage/audit selections. Fresh current-HEAD validation: `python -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_learning.py::test_learning_transition_rolls_back_event_and_projection_on_failure tests/test_agent_learning.py::test_learning_transition_retry_is_idempotent tests/test_agent_learning.py::test_slo_success_rate_uses_bounded_sliding_window tests/test_agent_learning.py::test_slo_window_persists_success_failure_and_minimum_sample_counts --tb=short` — 7 passed in 0.91s at HEAD 409bed4a6a73fd66175ad339c399f4277ed0ed99. Broad suite and live runtime remain unverified.

acceptance_criteria: SLO success-rate evaluation uses a bounded count or time window, not lifetime cumulative counters.
Persist success_count and failure_count for the active window and honor min_samples.
Rollback only after min_samples and when aggregate window success rate is below min_success_rate.
task_t07_slo_success_rate.description: Zavést časové nebo počtové okno s agregací success_count, failure_count, min_sample_count. Rollback pouze při překročení agregovaného failure rate. Priority: high.
task_t07_slo_success_rate.next_action: Added bounded rolling success window (window_size up to 64), persisted window count/success/failure counts and exact bit history in numeric metrics. min_samples gates aggregate success-rate rollback; observation success also requires zero error_count. Historical validation: rolling failures override earlier successes and persisted counts; 29 passed, 15 deselected across learning/storage/audit selections. Fresh current-HEAD validation included `test_slo_success_rate_uses_bounded_sliding_window` and `test_slo_window_persists_success_failure_and_minimum_sample_counts` in the 7-case A07/A08 selection: 7 passed in 0.91s at HEAD 409bed4a6a73fd66175ad339c399f4277ed0ed99.
